function_declarations.name: save_session_summary
function_declarations.description: Save the coaching session summary. Call this ONLY after you have recapped the session and the user agreed the recap is right, and BEFORE you say goodbye.

current_situation.description: The user's current role and situation in one or two sentences, as they described it

goal.description: The career goal the user agreed on, in their words

strengths.description: Two or three strengths drawn from the resume and the conversation

obstacles.description: What the user said is holding them back

resume_feedback.description: The specific resume improvements you suggested; empty if none

next_steps.description: The two or three concrete next steps the user agreed to, as a numbered list

follow_up_wanted.description: 'yes' or 'no': whether the user wants a follow-up session
